original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds UI functionality to highlight log lines by pod name.

corrected.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds highlighting of log lines by pod name in the UI. Every environment upgrading from a version before 3.0.0 gets this feature, and no configuration condition is stated.

decision.reason: [ev-a17ed311b248] lists this only as a UI feature in the v3.0.0 changelog and names no setting, flag or resource that controls it. So any environment upgrading from before 3.0.0 gets the feature. The proposed condition uses cluster-version with name argo-cd, but cluster-version is for the platform version, not the product itself. The product's own upgrade edge belongs in edge-from-version (in-range <3.0.0).
